key_insight: EHR-Complex is a large-scale benchmark that tests medical agents on realistic, interactive EHR reasoning rather than simplified SQL generation.
clinical_relevance: It better reflects how clinicians and researchers need to query complex longitudinal records, helping assess whether AI tools can reliably support EHR analysis at scale.
method: Built on MIMIC-IV with 365K patients, 31 tables, and 500M+ records.
Includes ~52K tasks across six clinical intents at both patient and population levels.
Requires agents to execute SQL or Python in a sandboxed interactive environment.
evidence_signal: In evaluation, the best model reached only 62.3% exact-match accuracy, and pass@4 consistency fell below 50% for nearly all models.
watch_item: The benchmark is highly demanding, so performance on EHR-Complex may not translate directly to safer or effective real-world clinical deployment without strong human oversight.
paper_title: EHR-Complex: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Complex Clinical Reasoning
